description: Crichton pushes deeper into wormhole physics as the crew reunites around Moya, Grayza and the Scarrans expand the conflict, and a brief return to Earth gives way to a final choice between home and the people Crichton now considers family.

s04e01.description: Separated from Moya, Crichton lives aboard the dying Leviathan Elack and works on wormhole theory until Sikozu and hostile harvesters arrive.

s04e02.description: Elack reaches an archaeological site where old allies reunite, but Grayza and the Peacekeepers turn the search for ancient probes into a siege.

s04e03.description: Crichton gambles on a dangerous plan involving Elack and Grayza while the crew races to recover the final probe and escape the poisoned world.

s04e04.description: Rygel's greed traps him in an alien substance inside a treasure cave, leaving Crichton and the others sealed in with armored scavengers and rising lava.

s04e05.description: The crew returns to Moya and finds Aeryn suffering from heat delirium with Scorpius already aboard under her protection.

s04e06.description: A fast-growing organism infests Moya and forces the crew to choose a leader while personal rivalries complicate the attempt to save the ship.

s04e07.description: Crichton enters a bizarre virtual game built from his memories, where distorted versions of friends and enemies keep changing the rules.

s04e08.description: Bounty hunters seize Moya and miniaturize members of the crew into crystalline storage, leaving the survivors to reverse the process before they are sold.

s04e09.description: Crichton becomes entangled in a local political succession crisis and murder investigation where every faction has a reason to manipulate the off-worlders.

s04e10.description: Contaminated food biologically links members of the crew in pairs, forcing enemies and lovers alike to remain close while they search for a cure.

s04e11.description: A powerful being shows Crichton alternate realities created by different wormhole choices and warns him how dangerous his knowledge has become.

s04e12.description: Crichton returns to 1980s Earth through a wormhole and discovers that his presence has altered history in ways that threaten his own future.

s04e13.description: Moya reaches contemporary Earth, giving Crichton the homecoming he wanted while the alien crew confronts humanity and its suspicions firsthand.

s04e14.description: A seemingly vulnerable passenger feeds on the crew's emotions, gradually weakening them while hiding her true nature behind sympathy and attraction.

s04e15.description: D'Argo enters a harsh mental-discipline training program and is forced to confront the man responsible for the death of Lo'Laan.

s04e16.description: Aeryn, Chiana, Noranti and Sikozu infiltrate a dangerous border operation to gather intelligence as Grayza's forces tighten their search.

s04e17.description: Crichton watches Earth's public reaction to the aliens through a documentary program while fear for Aeryn turns every debate about humanity painfully personal.

s04e18.description: Crichton seeks help through an alternate reality to locate Aeryn, while she endures Scarran interrogation centered on her pregnancy and Crichton's secrets.

s04e19.description: The crew launches a rescue at a Scarran facility to recover the pregnant Aeryn before her captors can use her child as leverage.

s04e20.description: Crichton and Scorpius bluff their way into a secret summit at Katratzi, using the threat of wormhole weapons to pit Peacekeepers and Scarrans against each other.

s04e21.description: The Katratzi operation turns into open combat as the crew tries to destroy the Scarrans' strategic advantage and escape before both empires close in.

s04e22.description: With Earth threatened through a wormhole, Crichton makes a painful choice to protect it and finally asks Aeryn to build a future with him.
